-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.MsgOut` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem msgOutR_msgOwn (γ : RaftNames) (l : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (st : MsgSt) : msgOutR γ l dq st ⊢
    msgOwn l dq st

theorem out_size (γ : RaftNames) (x : Loc × MsgC ⊕ Loc × EntryC) (b : Nat) : outSetR γ x ⊢
    ⌜γ.maxData = some b → outSizeOk x⌝

def snapUfT (l : Loc) (ty : w32) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜ty ≠ MsgSnap⌝ ∨ pbMsg raftpb.Message l [])

def EntryC.countable : Pos.Countable EntryC :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun c => Pos.Countable.encode (c.term, c.index, c.type, c.data, c.uf)) ⋯

def outSizeOk : Loc × MsgC ⊕ Loc × EntryC → Prop :=
  match x✝ with
  | Sum.inl (fst, c) => c.model.msg.Type' ≠ MsgSnap → msgSizeOk c
  | Sum.inr (fst, e) => entSizeOk e

theorem msgPtsC_msgPtsCC_uf (l : Loc) (dq dqe : DFrac) (cap : Bool) (st : MsgSt) (uf0 : List w8) :
    msgPtsC l dq dqe cap st ∗ pbMsg raftpb.Message l uf0 ⊢ ∃ c, msgPtsCC l dq dqe cap c ∗ ⌜c.model =
    st ∧ c.csUfNil ∧ c.f.uf = uf0⌝

def outEntR (γ : RaftNames) (e : Loc) (c : EntryC) : IProp GF :=
  outSetR γ (Sum.inr (e, c))

def entSizeOk (e : EntryC) : Prop :=
  entBytes e ≤ 2 ^ 31

theorem snapUf_congr (l : Loc) (st st' : MsgSt) (h : st'.msg.Type' = st.msg.Type') : snapUf l st ⊢
    snapUf l st'

def optSnapSize : Option SnapC → Nat :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => 0
  | some s => snapSize s

def MsgC.sentOk (c : MsgC) : Prop :=
  c.csUfNil ∧ (c.f.msgM.Type' = MsgSnap → c.f.uf = [])

def outObjR (γ : RaftNames) (m : Loc) (c : MsgC) : IProp GF :=
  outSetR γ (Sum.inl (m, c))

theorem snapUfT_persistent (l : Loc) (ty : w32) : Persistent (snapUfT l ty)

def CSC.countable : Pos.Countable CSC :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective
    (fun c => Pos.Countable.encode (c.voters, c.learners, c.votersOutgoing, c.learnersNext, c.autoLeave, c.uf)) ⋯

def msgSizeOk (c : MsgC) : Prop :=
  c.resps = [] ∧
    hdrBytes c ≤ 2 ^ 31 ∧
      (∀ (e : EntryC), e ∈ c.f.entries → entBytes e ≤ 2 ^ 31) ∧
        (List.map (fun e => entBytes e + 64) c.f.entries).sum ≤ 2 ^ 36

theorem msgOwn_snapUf_CC (l : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (st : MsgSt) : msgOwn l dq st ∗ snapUf l st ⊢ ∃ c,
    msgPtsCC l dq DFrac.discard false c ∗ ⌜c.model = st ∧ c.sentOk⌝

def SnapMetaC.countable : Pos.Countable SnapMetaC :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun c => Pos.Countable.encode (c.confState, c.index, c.term, c.uf)) ⋯

def outKey : Loc × MsgC ⊕ Loc × EntryC → Loc × MsgFC × List Loc ⊕ Loc × EntryC :=
  match x✝ with
  | Sum.inl (m, c) => Sum.inl (m, c.f, List.map Prod.fst c.resps)
  | Sum.inr x => Sum.inr x

def entBytes (e : EntryC) : Nat :=
  (e.data.getD []).length + e.uf.length

def MsgFC.countable : Pos.Countable MsgFC :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective
    (fun c =>
      Pos.Countable.encode
        ((c.type, c.to, c.frm, c.term, c.logTerm, c.index, c.entries), c.commit, c.vote, c.snapshot, c.reject,
          c.rejectHint, c.context, c.uf))
    ⋯

def msgOutR (γ : RaftNames) (l : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (st : MsgSt) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ c, msgPtsCC l dq DFrac.discard false c ∗ ⌜c.model = st ∧ c.sentOk⌝ ∗ outObjR γ l c)

theorem outObjR_size (γ : RaftNames) (m : Loc) (c : MsgC) (b : Nat) : outObjR γ m c ⊢ ⌜γ.maxData =
    some b → c.model.msg.Type' ≠ MsgSnap → msgSizeOk c⌝

def outSetR (γ : RaftNames) (x : Loc × MsgC ⊕ Loc × EntryC) : IProp GF :=
  Pos.Countable.encode (outKey x) ↪[γ.out]□ ()

def SnapC.countable : Pos.Countable SnapC :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun c => Pos.Countable.encode (c.data, c.metadata, c.uf)) ⋯

def hdrBytes (c : MsgC) : Nat :=
  (c.f.context.getD []).length + c.f.uf.length + optSnapSize c.f.snapshot

theorem outSetR_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (x : Loc × MsgC ⊕ Loc × EntryC) : Persistent (outSetR γ
    x)

def snapUf (l : Loc) (st : MsgSt) : IProp GF :=
  snapUfT l st.msg.Type'

theorem snapUfT_ne (l : Loc) (ty : w32) (h : ty ≠ MsgSnap) : ⊢ snapUfT l ty

theorem msgOutR_snap (γ : RaftNames) (l : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (st : MsgSt) : msgOutR γ l dq st ⊢ ∃ c,
    msgPtsCC l dq DFrac.discard false c ∗ outObjR γ l c ∗ ⌜c.model = st ∧ c.csUfNil ∧ (st.msg.Type'
    = MsgSnap → c.f.uf = [])⌝

theorem outEntR_size (γ : RaftNames) (e : Loc) (c : EntryC) (b : Nat) : outEntR γ e c ⊢ ⌜γ.maxData =
    some b → entSizeOk c⌝
